description: Pick which of your Claude Code accounts each VS Code window uses, and spread your weekly quota across the days. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.
command.removeAccount: Remove an account from the list…
config.accounts: Accounts and their profile folders. Empty = the account you already use with Claude Code (default profile, `~/.claude`) plus any existing `~/.claude-<name>` profiles with a sign-in. Managed from the status bar (**Add account…**). An empty `configDir` = default profile. The first account owns the shared history. One list for the local machine and remotes; each machine resolves `~` to its own home folder.
config.accounts.label: Name shown; by default, the part of the email before the @.
config.accounts.configDir: Profile folder (~ allowed). Empty = default profile.
config.defaultAccount: Id of the account a window uses before you pick one (A = Claude Code's default profile).
config.sharedFolders: Folders of the other accounts that link to the first one's. `projects` shares the history (for `/resume`). Others you can add: `skills`, `agents`, `commands`, `file-history`.
config.refreshIntervalMinutes: How often, in minutes, the usage Claude Code stored is re-read (no network requests).
config.statusBarUsage: What to show of the usage in the status bar.
config.language: Language of Relevo's status bar, messages and usage panel. Command names follow VS Code's display language.
